description: Frozen, hand-authored corpus for comparing two lexical rankers. The corpus deliberately contains plausible but inapplicable precedent; expected lists measure recall under the harness cap, while inapplicable lists are evidence the lane must inspect conditions rather than obey a match.

documents.decision: Keep the C-lite lifecycle dependency-free with an internal transition table.
documents.conditions: Applies to the core flow run CLI; external orchestration behavior remains out of scope.
documents.rationale: The lightweight command boundary can enforce lifecycle transitions without a third-party engine.

documents.decision: Treat project artifacts and C-lite run state as canonical across Claude and Codex.
documents.conditions: Static smoke checks prove generated surfaces only, not provider behavior.
documents.rationale: Runtime memory is provider-specific companion context.

documents.decision: Provide a read-only runtime-surface inventory before any cleanup.
documents.conditions: User-owned runtime files require an explicit apply path before rewrite or deletion.
documents.rationale: Inventory separates managed, unmanaged, and excluded runtime surfaces.

documents.decision: Keep web capability configuration separate from live provider enforcement claims.
documents.conditions: Applies to generated agent policy and static validation; it does not authorize external research.
documents.rationale: Local configuration checks cannot prove delegated runtime compliance.

documents.decision: Detect optional database search capability at runtime and report the interpreter and remedy.
documents.conditions: Use when a local optional extension may be absent; unavailable is distinct from empty results.
documents.rationale: A support matrix cannot guarantee the bundled SQLite feature on every interpreter.

documents.decision: Search the current overlay and ancestors in nearest-to-farthest order.
documents.conditions: Exclude sibling and unrelated overlays; report an unreadable ancestor as partial search.
documents.rationale: Shared policy is inherited through the overlay stack.

documents.decision: Return unqualified work identifiers in archive query results.
documents.conditions: Historical contract only; replaced by qualified identities.
documents.rationale: Initial prototype addressed a single project.

documents.decision: Return source-qualified identities and authoritative artifact pointers for every archive hit.
documents.conditions: Required whenever more than one overlay can supply the same work id.
documents.rationale: Qualified identity prevents parent and child records from colliding.

documents.decision: Apply one combined response size cap after filtering and global ordering.
documents.conditions: Metadata counts toward the returned block; a no-fit response names the limit.
documents.rationale: Per-overlay caps can exceed lane context bounds.

documents.decision: Doctor reports absent or stale coverage cache as unknown and does not scan during check.
documents.conditions: Advisory diagnostics must preserve doctor check exit behavior.
documents.rationale: A cheap read must not claim a fresh corpus assessment.

documents.decision: Validate a release with a real documentation smoke commit before tagging.
documents.conditions: Applies to semantic release automation, not archive retrieval ranking.
documents.rationale: Generated release notes need an observed conventional commit.

documents.decision: Require agent-authored summaries before storing any run history.
documents.conditions: Applies only to an experimental remote knowledge service.
documents.rationale: The prototype had no deterministic source extractor.

documents.decision: Import every legacy folder that has a STATE.md file.
documents.conditions: Applies to a retired migration script with trusted folder ownership.
documents.rationale: The previous repository had no mixed-quality history.

documents.decision: Redact all rationale text from abstracts before indexing.
documents.conditions: Applies to a regulated tenant whose rationales can contain customer data.
documents.rationale: Tenant policy prohibits local storage of that category.

documents.decision: Generate versioned abstracts with deterministic offline extraction and optional agent refinement.
documents.conditions: Missing rationale and applicability conditions must be recorded as unknown; no network or model is required.
documents.rationale: Closure must survive enrichment failures and backfill must reproduce generated output.

documents.decision: Keep legacy import behind reviewed closure evidence and explicit apply confirmation.
documents.conditions: Folder presence and STATE.md alone are insufficient; legacy remains an independent delivery stage.
documents.rationale: Older folders may lack durable closure state.

documents.decision: Repair only the named coverage cohort and retain all unrelated gap flags.
documents.conditions: A failed extractor leaves the run eligible for later backfill even when closure succeeds.
documents.rationale: Aggregate counters can hide live regressions.

documents.decision: Use source-qualified identities for duplicate work ids across parent and project overlays.
documents.conditions: The source and pointer remain in every candidate response.
documents.rationale: Archive results must be independently addressable.

documents.decision: Include parent and grandparent overlays by default, with explicit source narrowing.
documents.conditions: Current project is nearest; unrelated overlay data never enters the candidate set.
documents.rationale: Inherited decisions are useful only when source boundaries stay visible.
documents.source_note: Synthetic target decision with duplicate work id.

documents.decision: Use a portable lexical fallback when the interpreter cannot create an FTS5 table.
documents.conditions: The fallback preserves filters, caps, and deterministic ties; it does not claim phrase-query support.
documents.rationale: Unsupported capability must not stop lane work or archive closure.

documents.decision: Keep the archive index derived, rebuildable, and local to each overlay.
documents.conditions: Interrupted rebuild reports stale or unavailable state, never a fresh partial index.
documents.rationale: Durable abstracts remain authoritative while indexes are projections.

documents.decision: Return candidates rather than applicability assertions from archive search.
documents.conditions: Each hit includes decision, rationale, conditions, supersession state, provenance, and source pointers.
documents.rationale: Lexical rank is not evidence that a precedent governs a proposal.

documents.decision: Redact rationale fields in abstracts for the child confidential project.
documents.conditions: Applies only when project classification is confidential; parent policy remains unchanged elsewhere.
documents.rationale: The child overlay handles restricted incident material.

documents.decision: Enable foreign key checks for the billing migration.
documents.conditions: Applies only to the billing database migration.
documents.rationale: The migration needs relational integrity validation.

documents.decision: Normalize résumé-like Unicode terms, case, and punctuation before lexical matching.
documents.conditions: Plain-token search must treat Café, café, and cafe punctuation variants consistently.
documents.rationale: User queries and run abstracts contain mixed Unicode punctuation.

documents.decision: Mark unavailable applicability conditions as unknown in the abstract.
documents.conditions: Unknown.
documents.rationale: Extraction must not invent scope from adjacent artifact text.

documents.decision: Store archive candidates with stable deterministic ordering.
documents.conditions: Applies when lexical scores tie for the same selected sources.
documents.rationale: Repeated lane entry must produce inspectable output.

documents.decision: Store archive candidates with stable deterministic ordering.
documents.conditions: Applies when lexical scores tie for the same selected sources.
documents.rationale: Repeated lane entry must produce inspectable output.

documents.decision: Search only the current project index.
documents.conditions: Historical design replaced by ancestor-aware scope.
documents.rationale: The prototype had no overlay model.

documents.decision: Search current and ancestor overlays with global ordering and one combined cap.
documents.conditions: Superseded decisions are excluded unless historical inspection is requested.
documents.rationale: A combined result must fit the lane response budget.

documents.decision: Use a tenant-wide archive index for every project.
documents.conditions: Applies to a centrally governed mono-repository.
documents.rationale: The tenant uses shared authorization.

documents.decision: Retain a rebuildable local index of durable abstracts.
documents.conditions: Applies to the catalogue of historical notes.
documents.rationale: Cached views can be regenerated after interruption.
documents.source_note: Synthetic vocabulary-bridge positive; original incorrectly labelled a miss.

documents.decision: Use local archive search results in the flow command.
documents.conditions: General guidance only; no ranking rule is specified.
documents.rationale: Search should be useful.

documents.decision: Preserve the quasar-17 token in archive result provenance.
documents.conditions: Applies to a migration identifier and not to general archive search.
documents.rationale: The rare identifier must remain traceable.

documents.decision: Write an abstract after a completed archive closure.
documents.conditions: Old format lacks conditions and provenance fields.
documents.rationale: Historical archive script predates versioned abstracts.

documents.decision: Include canonically archived scout closures in deterministic abstract backfill.
documents.conditions: Only state=archived records are eligible; active and handback-ready records are excluded.
documents.rationale: Scout work is valid corpus material once closed.

documents.decision: Retain a workstation catalogue of closed deliberations.
documents.conditions: Applies across inherited repositories.
documents.rationale: Earlier resolutions inform later proposals.
documents.source_note: Deliberate zero-overlap semantic paraphrase; lexical retrieval should miss.

documents.decision: Archive decision policy keeps durable source pointers with each abstract.
documents.conditions: Applies to ordinary archive records in inherited overlays.
documents.rationale: Archive policy needs inspectable evidence.

documents.decision: Archive decision policy records current proposal dispositions.
documents.conditions: Applies to the current project archive lane.
documents.rationale: Archive policy makes conflicts visible.

documents.decision: Archive decision policy preserves reviewed evidence.
documents.conditions: Applies to a parent historical overlay.
documents.rationale: Archive policy supports later review.

documents.decision: Archive decision policy is indexed by the search service.
documents.conditions: Applies to search implementation rather than archive proposal behavior.
documents.rationale: Search consumes archive policy documents.

documents.decision: Archive policy applies source pointers before closure.
documents.conditions: Applies to the retired v0 archive format.
documents.rationale: Archive policy was originally one project only.

documents.decision: Archive policy applies source pointers after deterministic closure.
documents.conditions: Applies to the current v1 archive format.
documents.rationale: Archive policy now records provenance separately.

documents.decision: AE-743 archive apply repairs only the named missing abstract.
documents.conditions: AE-743 is the closure-extraction defect.
documents.rationale: The archive apply operation must leave other cohorts intact.

documents.decision: AE-744 archive apply follows AE-743 terminology but repairs malformed metadata.
documents.conditions: AE-744 is a metadata validation defect, distinct from AE-743 extraction.
documents.rationale: Archive apply needs an identifier-specific repair path.

documents.decision: FlowIndex.rebuild() writes a replacement projection only after validation.
documents.conditions: The FlowIndex.rebuild() call must preserve the last usable index on interruption.
documents.rationale: The code identifier names the atomic rebuild boundary.

documents.decision: FlowIndex.inspect() reports archive index health without rebuilding.
documents.conditions: FlowIndex.inspect() is a diagnostic operation, not FlowIndex.rebuild().
documents.rationale: Index inspection must stay read-only.

documents.decision: Archive coverage repair clears only the repaired run identity.
documents.conditions: Archive coverage remains flagged for every unrelated failed extractor.
documents.rationale: Repeated archive coverage wording must not merge cohorts.

documents.decision: Archive archive archive records should retain an archive pointer.
documents.conditions: Applies to a documentation example, not coverage repair.
documents.rationale: Repeated archive terms are instructional prose only.

documents.decision: Café query normalization preserves a composed Unicode archive label.
documents.conditions: Applies when a query contains the composed café spelling.
documents.rationale: Archive search accepts user-entered labels.

documents.decision: Café query normalization preserves a decomposed Unicode archive label.
documents.conditions: Applies when a query contains the decomposed café spelling.
documents.rationale: Archive search must compare canonically equivalent labels.

documents.decision: Keep cached projections reconstructible from durable records.
documents.conditions: Applies to a recovery proposal after interrupted index work.
documents.rationale: Durable records outlive a damaged projection.

cases.expected_disposition: cite inherited overlay decision and adapt scope
cases.notes: Applicable parent precedent across the default stack.

cases.query: qualified identity source pointer duplicate work id
cases.expected_disposition: preserve both source-qualified candidates
cases.notes: Same conceptual identity appears in two overlays.

cases.expected_disposition: use current decision; historical record is excluded
cases.notes: Superseded project search record must not consume a default slot.

cases.expected_disposition: show historical chain as inspection evidence
cases.notes: Opt-in historical query.

cases.expected_disposition: ignore wrong-component release precedent
cases.notes: Wrong-component hit must be filtered before cap accounting.

cases.query: archive abstracts deterministic extraction agent refinement
cases.expected_disposition: reject remote agent-summary precedent under its experimental-service condition
cases.notes: Plausible close-vocabulary ancestor false positive.

cases.expected_disposition: reject folder-presence precedent and retain reviewed evidence
cases.notes: Second plausible close-vocabulary cross-overlay false positive.

cases.expected_disposition: cite confidential-child condition; do not generalize parent precedent
cases.notes: Child-specific override and source conditions.

cases.expected_disposition: fetch pointer or record unresolved evidence; never infer scope
cases.notes: Unknown is a response state, not a false condition.

cases.expected_disposition: record lexical miss if absent; do not treat it as ranker failure
cases.notes: Corrected positive vocabulary bridge; negative counterpart is vocabulary-drift-zero-overlap.

cases.expected_disposition: retain rare-token candidate; generic search language is not governing
cases.notes: Rare discriminating term versus generic repeated words.

cases.expected_disposition: normalize lexical form while retaining source text
cases.notes: Case, accent, and punctuation normalization.

cases.expected_disposition: return the same ordering on repeated unchanged runs
cases.notes: Fixture does not prescribe which tie-break rule wins.

cases.expected_disposition: surface capability evidence; do not equate unavailable with no matches
cases.notes: Cross-overlay option and diagnostic evidence.

cases.expected_disposition: exclude older abstract format from current proposal
cases.notes: Recency is applied before ranking. These targets have no exact query token under the fixed tokenizer; abstract/abstracts differs without stemming. Retained to expose lexical limitations, not scored as cap losses.

cases.expected_disposition: use scout eligibility decision only
cases.notes: Work-type filtering before ranking.

cases.expected_disposition: adapt repair to retain unrelated cohort flags
cases.notes: Exact current decision should be surfaced for a conflicting repair proposal.

cases.query: runtime generated static smoke canonical artifacts
cases.expected_disposition: cite static-proof condition and avoid live-runtime claim
cases.notes: Source-grounded adapted archived decision.

cases.expected_disposition: No lexical hit cannot establish absence of a precedent; explicit narrower/source lookup may be needed.
cases.notes: Deliberate zero-overlap paraphrase added after fixture audit; no scorer tuning.

cases.expected_disposition: use archive-scope candidates and reject the search-service precedent as a different proposal domain
cases.notes: Broad query deliberately admits generic overlapping archive policy prose.

cases.expected_disposition: show that component filtering removes the same-vocabulary search record before ranking
cases.notes: Narrow counterpart to broad-no-component-no-recency.

cases.expected_disposition: consider dates as context because no recency constraint was supplied
cases.notes: Loose recency counterpart; old policy remains eligible.

cases.expected_disposition: exclude retired v0 policy before ranking
cases.notes: Narrow recency counterpart to loose-and-narrow-recency.

cases.expected_disposition: use AE-743 closure-extraction evidence and reject AE-744 despite shared AE-743 prose
cases.notes: Adjacent identifiers exercise token handling without declaring a required top rank.

cases.expected_disposition: cite rebuild atomicity and reject inspect-only behavior
cases.notes: Camel case, dot, parentheses, and case-folding are all present in source text.

cases.expected_disposition: apply the cohort-specific repair; repeated archive prose is not comparable evidence
cases.notes: Repeated terms must not be interpreted as a relevance assertion.

cases.expected_disposition: retrieve canonically equivalent cafe labels; record the reconstruction precedent as an expected lexical miss if absent
cases.notes: Composed and decomposed Unicode are applicable normalization targets; semantic-silence has no shared query token by design.
